title: Validity of cell sources
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let $\ell$ be a finite list of bit sources, and let $T,n,t\in\mathbb{N}$, $\tau<k$, and $r<2T+1$, where $k$ is the number of work tapes of $M$. Every source in the list constructed for cell $(t,\tau,r)$ is valid with input length $n$, block width equal to the snapshot width of $M$ plus $5$, and current block index equal to the cell index of $(t,\tau,r)$; that is, each input source refers to an index below $n$, and each block source refers to an earlier block and a bit index below that width.
hypotheses_covered: A finite Turing machine $M$ over the binary alphabet
A finite list $\ell$ of bit sources
$\tau<k$, where $k$ is the number of work tapes
